decision.status: Ajuste restrito das filas validado funcionalmente; ganho de throughput inconclusivo e aceite Vanilla aberto.
decision.interpretation: A mudança de layout/leitura recupera apenas0,69% na média de Fuji contra v12 e fica cerca de0,84% abaixo da v11 desta mesma rodada. Skorost preserva o ganho da v12 contra v11, mas o ajuste adicional fica praticamente neutro. As outras médias variam menos de0,1%, próximas do teto nominal. Isso não resolve a câmera lenta nem sustenta uma nova melhoria geral de desempenho; as caudas/intervalos longos também apresentam resultados adversos. Retém-se o ajuste pequeno e os testes, com as baselines disponíveis, sem promover a v13 como versão de60FPS estáveis.
decision.next_performance: Fuji continua P0: medir ciclos por kernel VU e custo de notificações/esperas com contadores de CPU; o layout não isolou a causa da queda v12. Avaliar espera adaptativa/batching somente com novo protocolo, equivalência e medidas de CPU/cadência.
decision.next_performance_en: Keep Fuji throughput P0: profile VU kernels and notification/idle transitions with CPU counters; fixed64-spin screening remains rejected, and the prior v12 regression is not closed.
decision.screen_reason: Two exploratory pairs per scene only; fixed64-spin fails the predeclared3% Fuji effort gate and Fuji callback long intervals increased. Not a proof of no benefit; do not install as a default. Source restored immediately after build; all rows retained.

coverage: mixed packet types and byte-exact variable payloads
per-packet consumer acknowledgement and repeated empty waits

native_async_queue_stream.method: Actual candidate queue source plus temporary diagnostic hooks: independent reference copy from each producer input before head release, exact header/payload memcmp at consumer peek, monotonic sequence advanced only at pop; repeated unconsumed peeks supported. No hashes or sampling used for this equality check.

initial_harness_failure.cause: Probe v1 incorrectly advanced its consumer sequence at peek. Renderer may return before consuming when its time budget expires, then peek the same packet again. Fixed diagnostic to advance sequence at pop; initial failed logs/probe retained privately. Not a production-queue failure.

native_async_queue_stream.limits: Intrusive diagnostic prefixes corroborate actual queue transfer/order; not a race-freedom proof or original/native visual parity. Synchronous image captures do not exercise these asynchronous queues.
